record.edic_text:
167 akatharsia {ak-ath-ar-see'-ah}

from 169; TDNT - 3:427,381; n f

AV - uncleanness 10; 10

1) uncleanness
   1a) physical
   1b) in a moral sense: the impurity of lustful, luxurious,
       profligate living
       1b1) of impure motives

same.cexp: 不純潔，不道德；不良的動機；污穢，腐爛
潔淨，使純潔；宣佈在禮儀上為可悅納的
潔淨的，乾淨的；純潔的，無罪的
